summary: The delivery push was refused by the forge.

failure.title: The forge's branch protection refused the push
failure.explanation: A protected branch rule or pre-receive hook on the forge declined Pidgen's push to main.
failure.fix: Let Pidgen's forge account push to the branch, or deliver to an unprotected branch, then retry the run.

technical.excerpt: remote: error: GH006: Protected branch update failed for refs/heads/main. | remote: error: Changes must be made through a pull request.
